payout_quote: Refer your friends, family members, and co-workers and you could earn $75 for each qualified referral that joins NGFCU.
steps: Complete the referral form on ngfcu.us.
Your friend opens an NGFCU savings and checking account and joins as a member.
Friend completes the qualifying steps within 90 days (10 debit transactions + opt out of paper statements; 2 direct deposits of $100+).
catches: Cap: $750 per calendar year to a single referrer (10 referrals).

Friend must open BOTH savings and checking, complete 10 debit transactions and opt out of paper statements within 90 days, plus 2 direct deposits of at least $100 each — all required for full qualification.
Referrer must be a current NGFCU member in good standing, 18+.
Awards paid as deposits into your NGFCU regular share savings account and are subject to taxation.
NGFCU reserves the right to change or cancel the program at any time.
biggest_catch: Your friend must complete the full checklist — savings + checking opened, 10 debit transactions, paperless statements, and 2 direct deposits of $100+ within 90 days — or you earn nothing; capped at $750/year.
eligibility: Current Northrop Grumman FCU member in good standing, 18+; referred person must be eligible for NGFCU membership.
timing: Referral form takes ~10 minutes; awards deposited to share savings after the friend completes 90-day requirements.
